Built for African independent artists

Everything you need to distribute worldwide, in one platform.

Global distribution

One upload. 150+ platforms. Your music on Spotify, Apple Music, Boomplay, Audiomack and every major DSP worldwide.

Royalty tracking

Every stream tracked and reported clearly. See your earnings per release, per store, every month. Transparent and honest.

Flexible payouts

Withdraw by Mobile Money in Ghana and Nigeria, or by bank transfer anywhere with your SWIFT/BIC code. Payouts are processed within 5–7 business days of your request.

Analytics dashboard

See your streams, your top performing releases and your growth over time. Artist+ and Label add store-level analytics, so you know exactly what's working.

Label management

Manage multiple artists under one account. Built for labels, collectives and managers. The Label plan includes 5 artists.

Reviewed before release

Every release is checked before it goes out, so metadata and artwork problems are caught early. After release, support handles updates and takedowns within 3–5 business days.

Common questions

Still stuck? Email info@blakkstonemusic.com.

How long does it take for my music to go live?

We require at least 10 business days' lead time before your release date, to process and deliver your music to stores. Spotify and Apple Music usually take 3–5 days. You'll receive an email once your release is live.

How do I get paid?

You can request payouts via Mobile Money (Ghana and Nigeria) or direct bank transfer worldwide with your SWIFT/BIC code. All payments are processed within 5–7 business days of your request. Pricing is shown in your local currency for reference, though your actual subscription charge is processed in Ghana Cedis (GHS) via Paystack.

Does Blakkstone take a commission on my royalties?

No. Blakkstone takes 0% commission on every plan, so you keep 100% of the royalties you earn. A small service fee applies when you withdraw, and you'll see the exact amount before you confirm each payout request.

Can I distribute compilations or Various Artists albums?

Yes. Our submission wizard supports both standard Artist/Band releases and Compilation/Various Artists albums. You can add multiple primary and featured artists per track.

What audio formats are accepted?

We accept WAV, FLAC, and MP3 files. For best quality on all platforms we recommend 16-bit, 44.1kHz stereo WAV — MP3 is a compressed format, so its quality loss is permanent, but it's accepted if that's what you have.

Do I keep my rights when I distribute through Blakkstone?

Absolutely. You retain 100% ownership of your master recordings and compositions. Blakkstone only acts as a distribution channel — your music always belongs to you.

Can I remove or update a release after it's live?

Yes. Contact our support team via the dashboard messages and we'll process update requests (metadata corrections, artwork changes) or takedowns within 3–5 business days.

Is Blakkstone available outside Ghana?

Yes. Blakkstone accepts artists from across Africa — including Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, and Kenya — and worldwide. Mobile Money (MTN, Vodafone Cash, AirtelTigo Money) covers Ghana, and bank transfer with your SWIFT/BIC code gets you paid anywhere, including Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, and beyond — while your music goes out to Spotify, Apple Music, Boomplay, and 150+ stores no matter where you're based.

Do you accept mixtapes?

Yes. Alongside singles, EPs, and albums, we distribute mixtapes to Spotify, Apple Music, Boomplay, and 150+ stores worldwide — just submit it the same way you would any other release.

Ready to go worldwide?

Create a free account, submit your first release, and get paid by Mobile Money or bank transfer.

                    A Note on Fake Streams & Stream Farming

                    Streams from bots, click farms, or paid "stream farming" services are actively detected by Spotify, Apple Music, and other stores. They earn zero royalties and are stripped from your public counts the moment they're caught — regardless of how they were generated. Stores can also fine distributors per flagged track, and those fines get passed on to the artist responsible. Severe or repeated cases can mean tracks or entire releases being pulled, and accounts being suspended or permanently terminated. Please only promote your music through genuine listeners. Full details are in our Terms of Service.

                        Quick Answers
                        How long until my release goes live?
                        We require at least 10 business days' lead time before your release date, to process and deliver your music to stores. Spotify and Apple Music usually take 3–5 days. You'll see the status update on the release's own page, and get an email once it's live.
                        How do withdrawals work?
                        Request a payout via Mobile Money or Bank Transfer from the Royalties page — a 2% fee applies, shown clearly before you confirm. Processed within 5–7 business days.
                        Can I fix a mistake after submitting?
                        If it's still Pending or in Review, open the release and use "Edit Details" to fix it directly — no need to cancel and resubmit. Once it's Approved, message us below instead.
                        What audio formats do you accept?
                        WAV, FLAC, or AIFF are best — lossless masters preserve full quality. We recommend 16-bit, 44.1kHz stereo. MP3 is also accepted, but its quality loss is permanent and can't be recovered, so use a lossless file if you have one.
                        How do I add a team member?
                        Label plan accounts can invite a Manager or Viewer from Profile → Team Access. Neither can touch billing or payouts.
